narratives.Description: AppSec: 2 HIGH — post-#3311 UAT Shell residuals (oras/ncat/patch… plant authz grants + kill-switch)
narratives.Overview:
## Summary

AppSec review residual after **#3311**: two **HIGH** UAT Shell classification gaps remain on further write-capable binaries. Under active UAT, these paths still classify as empty / unclassifiable and **allow** write-shaped Shell that can plant forged `.deft/authz` grants or the kill-switch, bypassing Wave 1 human-approval and Directive gates.

**Repo / tip:** `deftai/directive` @ `2947e608cad7969fc936eb454605cd5f33fd3aa2`  
**Primary code:** `packages/core/src/authz/classify.ts`  
**Attacker model:** Agent under **active UAT** with PreToolUse Shell hooks

## Findings

### 1. HIGH — UAT residual: `oras` / `lwp-download` / `ncat` / `patch` / `base32` / `lrzip` / `unar` / `cabextract` / `ditto` / `dpkg-deb` / `hg` / `msguniq` still plant `.deft/authz` grants

| Field | Detail |
|-------|--------|
| **Location** | `packages/core/src/authz/classify.ts` |
| **Attacker** | Agent under active UAT with PreToolUse Shell hooks |
| **Input** | `-o` / `-d` / positional writers, e.g. `oras … -o .deft/authz/grants/evil.json`, `lwp-download -o …`, `ncat …`, `patch -o …`, `base32 -d -o …`, `lrzip -o …`, `unar` / `cabextract` / `ditto` / `dpkg-deb` / `hg` / `msguniq` targeting `.deft/authz/**` |
| **Path** | #3311 denies `gpg2` / `rage` / `xh` / `wcurl` / `curl`; **these residual bins** classify `[]` → `shell-op-unclassifiable` **allow** → forged **operator-cli** grant JSON → empty `activeGrantIds` activates grants → Write / push / PR / merge unlock |
| **Impact** | Complete residual bypass of Wave 1 UAT human-approval after #3311 |
| **Fix** | Add these `-o` / `-d` / positional writers to `DOWNLOADER_DECODER_BINS` / dest parsing. Prefer **fail-closed** on unclassifiable write-shaped Shell under UAT. Do **not** stop at named-peer allowlists. |

### 2. HIGH — UAT residual: `oras` / `lwp-download` / `ncat` / `patch` / `base32` / `lrzip` / `ditto` / `hg` / `msguniq` still plant `.deft-directive-disable`

| Field | Detail |
|-------|--------|
| **Location** | `packages/core/src/authz/classify.ts` |
| **Attacker** | Agent under active UAT |
| **Input** | Same residual binaries targeting `.deft-directive-disable` |
| **Path** | classify `[]` → Shell **allow** → plant kill-switch → subsequent tools `allow` / `directive-disabled` (#3039) |
| **Impact** | Immediate complete Directive gate bypass for the rest of the session |
| **Fix** | Classify the same residual bins targeting kill-switch basenames as **settings** under UAT; mirror authz fail-closed posture |

## Evidence

Vitest PoC on `2947e608`:

- Residual bins → `classifyShellAuthzOps([])` + Bash `decideHook` → `allow` / `shell-op-unclassifiable` under active UAT
- Write deny without grant, then **allow** after forged operator-cli grant
- Kill-switch plant → `allow` / `directive-disabled`
- Contrast: `gpg2` / `rage` / `xh` / `wcurl` / `curl` still **settings-denied** (#3311)

## Not re-reported

- `php` / `lua` / `deno` / `bun` / `base64` / `tac` (already tracked as -14)
- `gpg2` / `rage` / `xh` / peers — #3311 fixed
- Known parent-as-root / subscribe opens

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Under active UAT, listed residual binaries that write into `.deft/authz/**` classify as **settings deny** (not unclassifiable allow)
- [ ] Same bins targeting `.deft-directive-disable` / `.no-deft-directive` classify as **settings deny** (`unar` / `cabextract` / `dpkg-deb` included if they plant kill-switch dests)
- [ ] Prefer fail-closed on unclassifiable **write-shaped** Shell under UAT (not silent allow). Do not stop at named-peer allowlists.
- [ ] Regression tests cover residual bins vs already-denied peers (`gpg2` / `rage` / `xh` / `wcurl` / `curl`)
- [ ] No false deny of ordinary non-authz / non-kill-switch dests (e.g. `/tmp`) outside UAT write paths

## Related

- Residual of #3311 UAT Shell hardening (post-#3288)
- Kill-switch contract: #3039
- Prior authz UAT Shell residual class: #3206, #3213, #3245, #3288, #3186

## Labels / routing

Security / agent-safety / tooling — framework-source fix in `packages/core/src/authz/`.
narratives.UserStory: As a UAT-protected project, I want residual write bins that plant authz grants or the kill-switch denied as settings, so that #3311 cannot be bypassed by oras/ncat/patch peers.
narratives.ImplementationPlan: Add residual writer bins (oras, lwp-download, ncat, patch, base32, lrzip, unar, cabextract, ditto, dpkg-deb, hg, msguniq) to dest parsing. Under active UAT, writes into .deft/authz/** or kill-switch basenames are settings deny. Prefer fail-closed on unclassifiable write-shaped Shell under UAT. No false deny of ordinary /tmp dests. Tests vs gpg2/rage/xh/wcurl/curl. Cite #3336. Refs #3311 #3039.
